7019.59 — glass fibre woven fabrics, other (not of rovings) — matches 'Fiberglass Loom-state Fabric', 'High Silica Fiberglass Fabrics/Cloth', 'Fiberglass Aluminium Filtration Fabrics', 'Dust Collection Bags - Filtration Bags', 'Poly Glass', 'Easy Tear Fabric'
7019.64 — glass fibre woven fabrics of rovings (prepreg/coated) — matches 'Woven Roving', 'Fiberglass Silicon Coated Fabrics', 'Fiberglass Coated Fabrics'
7019.66 — glass fibre mats/webs (non-woven) — plausible for non-woven tubular bags / gauntlets, but not explicitly stated on site
7019.90 — other articles of glass fibre — matches 'Multi/Pluri Tubular Bags (Gauntlets)', 'Combo Bags', 'Fiberglass Combo Bags'

product_summary: Manufacturer of technical textiles from man-made/glass yarns. Own site (ketex.com) lists: Multi/Pluri Tubular Bags (Gauntlets) for lead-acid battery anodes; High Silica Fiberglass Fabrics/Cloth; Fiberglass Engineered Yarn & Roving; Fiberglass Loom-state Fabric; Fiberglass Aluminium Filtration Fabrics (mesh fabric for molten aluminium filtration); Fiberglass Silicon Coated Fabrics; Woven Roving; Fiberglass Coated Fabrics; Fiberglass Combo Bags; Dust Collection Bags / Filtration Bags; Poly Glass; Polyester Easy Tear Fabric; Polyester Resin Plastic Components; Float Valve (float level indicator); PVC Silica Separators for lead-acid batteries. Plants: Kharagpur (WB), Gagret/Una (HP), Bommasandra Bangalore (KA), plus Dhaka (Bangladesh) — per amer-sil.com/locations. Claims to be largest tubular-bag maker in India/Bangladesh (1.2 m pcs/day; 700 m linear metres of tubes annually — the two figures on the site are internally inconsistent, so treat volumes as unverified).
role_hint: manufacturer (own weaving, coating and resin-processing plants; JV with AMER-SIL S.A., Luxembourg). No trader signs found on the site.
comment: HS mapping: declared 701919 / 701966 / 701990 are all within Chapter 70 glass fibre and are broadly consistent with the glass-fibre fabric, roving and gauntlet lines — hence 'partial', not 'wrong'. Corrections/additions needed: (1) 7019.59 should be added for the plain woven glass-fibre fabrics (loom-state fabric, high-silica cloth, filtration fabrics) — the declared set has no woven-fabric-of-non-roving line; (2) 7019.64 for woven rovings and silicon/coated glass fabrics; (3) 7019.66 (mats/non-woven) is only inferable from 'non-woven tubular bags' — mark as заявлено, не подтверждено, no product page confirms a mat/web line; (4) a significant part of the range is NOT glass fibre at all and is missing from the declaration: PVC silica battery separators (plastics/accumulator parts, ~8507.90 or Ch.39), plastic components and float valves (3926.90), and polyester/poly-glass technical fabrics and filter bags (Ch.59/63). Industry claim 'Строительство и DIY' (construction & DIY) is a misclassification: the real end-markets are lead-acid battery manufacturing, aluminium smelting/molten-metal filtration, boiler-house flue-gas filtration, automotive and electrical insulation — i.e. industrial technical textiles, not construction/DIY. No customs line was available to me in this task, so all product-to-HS links above are derived from the company's own catalogue (ketex.com) and are therefore заявлено, не подтверждено at shipment level; per project rule 3 the HS discrepancy is not a rejection ground — company retained, codes corrected. Note: ketex.in is an unrelated textile-ceramics firm (Ketex Industrial Handling Pvt Ltd) and must not be used as a source for this entity.
